debrief db-021
1) the actor e-n-r-o-l-l-e-d a f-a-l-s-e b-i-o-m-e-t-r-i-c p-r-o-f-i-l-e into the r-e-g-i-s-t-e-r and left an o-r-p-h-a-n e-n-t-r-y while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the d-u-p-l-i-c-a-t-e d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k
2) the actor b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d the h-a-r-d-w-a-r-e t-o-k-e-n v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n at the e-n-t-r-y g-a-t-e and left a s-t-a-l-e a-u-d-i-t r-e-c-o-r-d while i-g-n-o-r-i-n-g the t-w-o-f-a-c-t-o-r m-a-t-c-h s-t-e-p
3) the actor t-a-i-l-o-r-e-d the l-o-g f-i-l-t-e-r r-u-l-e-s to h-i-d-e a-c-c-e-s-s e-v-e-n-t-s and left a g-a-p in the t-i-m-e l-i-n-e while b-y-p-a-s-s-i-n-g the i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n
4) the actor r-e-u-s-e-d a l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e b-a-d-g-e i-d for a l-a-t-e r-e-p-l-a-y and left a d-u-p-l-i-c-a-t-e s-t-a-m-p while o-v-e-r-l-o-o-k-i-n-g the s-e-s-s-i-o-n c-o-r-r-e-l-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k
5) the actor c-l-o-s-e-d the i-n-c-i-d-e-n-t r-e-p-o-r-t t-o-o e-a-r-l-y and left an u-n-r-e-s-o-l-v-e-d a-l-e-r-t while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the p-o-s-t-i-n-g c-l-e-a-n-u-p r-e-v-i-e-w
